visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a highly realistic ceramic cup designed to look exactly like a Portuguese egg tart, showcasing the detailed glazed crust and dark brown interior. The background features stacks of minimalist white and black boxes on light wooden shelving. (2) A fast-paced montage displays various bread and pastry-shaped souvenirs, including pineapple buns and croissants, each individually wrapped in clear plastic bags. A hand reaches out to touch and pick up a large yellow pineapple bun-shaped object from a display shelf. (3) An outdoor panoramic shot captures the historic Ruins of St. Paul's in Macau under an overcast sky. A diverse crowd of tourists in casual clothing is seen walking across the paved plaza and taking photos of the large stone facade. (4) The main character, a young male wearing a grey knit beanie and a tan padded vest over a dark shirt, smiles playfully while showing off a ring shaped like a tiny egg tart. The indoor shop setting is brightly lit. (5) The camera focuses on the packaging of the '35' brand egg tart cup as a hand slides a box from the stack. Close-up shots follow, showing the hand turning the ceramic cup to reveal the underside's realistic pastry texture. (6) The ceramic egg tart cup is positioned as a condiment dish on a dining table, holding a vibrant orange-colored dipping sauce. It sits next to a plate of freshly steamed white dumplings and a small dish of soy sauce. (7) The man is seen inside a modern airport cafe with soft overhead lighting. He holds a real, warm egg tart in his hand and takes a big bite while looking directly at the camera with a satisfied and happy expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male voice begins narrating in Mandarin with enthusiastic projection. An upbeat electronic pop track starts simultaneously, featuring a strong 4/4 drum beat and bright, melodic synthesizer textures. The audio environment is clean, resembling a post-produced studio recording with no initial noise. (2) A distinct plastic rustling sound occurs as the speaker handles souvenir items, triggering this new acoustic phase. The background music continues at a steady 120 BPM. The narrator's voice shows high pitch variability and a high-arousal, cheerful tone that dominates the mix. (3) A significant acoustic texture shift marks this phase as the environment changes to an outdoor setting with a natural wind floor and distant, muffled crowd chatter. The BGM and the narrator's clear, projected voice remain consistent, layered over the low-frequency outdoor ambient noise. (4) The audio returns to a clean indoor room tone as the narrator describes themed accessories. The male speaker's vocal arousal remains very high, and the BGM's percussive elements are crisp. There is no interference from external noise, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio. (5) A sharp cardboard sliding sound and a light percussive thud are heard as a product box is manipulated. The narrator continues his fast-paced delivery, focusing on the egg tart cup. The music's rhythmic energy stays constant, providing a driving force behind the speech. (6) A short, percussive crunching sound is heard as the narrator bites into an actual tart. His speech becomes slightly breathy and muffled due to eating but remains friendly and encouraging. The music swells slightly in volume as the video reaches its concluding recommendation.
